proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_regime + by_signal_type×sector + by_signal_type = Choppy (regime) / UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank & UP_TRI×Choppy×Energy (cells) / UP_TRI (signal) (100.0%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + by_signal_type×sector + by_signal_type = Choppy (regime) / UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank & UP_TRI×Choppy×Energy (cells) / UP_TRI (signal); recommended action: Pause new UP_TRI entries in Bank and Energy sectors until natural exits reduce each cell below 0.20 share; block any additional Choppy-regime longs until regime diversifies or Choppy×UP_TRI cohort promotes to Tier M/S. Consider a Bank Nifty hedge to offset the 25% Bank cluster.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If Choppy regime breaks to Bear or a sharp Bank/Energy sector drawdown hits, 100% of the book is directionally long UP_TRI with unvalidated edge — 46.88% of positions concentrated in just two sectors would take correlated losses with no offsetting exposure.
